title.zh: Bitget’s hack just got $36 million bigger, and now there’s a bounty on the stolen crypto
title.en: Bitget’s hack just got $36 million bigger, and now there’s a bounty on the stolen crypto

current_state.zh: Bitget raised the estimated loss from its Sept. 24 hot-wallet breach to $387.5 million after on-chain tracing uncovered additional Zcash and TRON assets, and has put a bounty on the stolen funds while Mandiant and SlowMist continue forensic work.
current_state.en: Bitget raised the estimated loss from its Sept. 24 hot-wallet breach to $387.5 million after on-chain tracing uncovered additional Zcash and TRON assets, and has put a bounty on the stolen funds while Mandiant and SlowMist continue forensic work.
